chain.month_blocked_fits: The shipped ranking path fits five layers' offsets on the labels of all twelve 2025 months, which include February / June. For F these fits are month-blocked, as each layer's own development / twelve-month form ('every other 2025 month'): each of steps 2, 7-8, 9 and 10 runs twice, once with February 2025 and once with June 2025 removed from every fit over all twelve months (run_rematch_nonm.offsets; run_intruder_bound.fit, run_intruder_identity.fit, run_own_motion.fit, which run_own_motion_v2 calls), and its output takes February rows from the first run and June rows from the second. Fits the tools make over fewer months (their own month-blocked twelve-month tables, e.g. the intruder-bound table under the identity extension) are left as they are: the held month's labels reach them only through other months' table values (candidate selection), a second-order effect, disclosed. Steps 3-6 and 11-15 fit on the four development months (January, July, November, December 2025) only, so they are out of sample for February / June as on the final file. Every wrapped call is logged in work/chain_tierb.json.
